title: refinementList with a sub refinementList
body:
Hello,

Is it possible to create a new widget that can handle sub refinements lists?

So for example we want to show brand + model in 1 refinement list like this:
- Brand 1
   - Model 1
   - Model 2
-Brand 2
   - Model 3
   - Model 4
- Brand 3
   - Model 5
etc.

Brand 1, 2 and 3 is generated by the attribute brand, model 1, 2, 3 etc by the attribute model but shows only the models that are available with the brandname that is listed above the models list.

Is this already available?

comments.body: Did you take a look at [HierarchicalMenu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#hierarchicalmenu)?
@Haroenv Yeah, that does almost suite my needs, but I want it to be possible to select multiple brands. Is that possible?

Not right now, because it has significant implications on lower levels of our libraries, but it is in our longer-term plan.

See also https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2053

Have a great day!
